headline: Duchess of Edinburgh arrives in Bangladesh Monday for UK-BD partnership visit
summary: The Duchess of Edinburgh will visit Bangladesh from Monday to Wednesday to strengthen UK-Bangladesh ties and assess Rohingya support programs. She will meet with top officials and visit key institutions.
details: The Duchess of Edinburgh is arriving in Bangladesh on Monday for a three-day visit aimed at bolstering the UK-Bangladesh partnership. Her itinerary includes engagements with various communities and organizations, as well as a firsthand look at the conditions of the Rohingya population in Cox's Bazar.

During her stay in Dhaka, the Duchess is scheduled to meet with President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir and Prime Minister’s wife Zubaida Rahman. Discussions will center on mutual interests concerning the welfare, protection, and empowerment of women and children.

The Duchess will also visit the Bangladesh Institute of Peace Support Operation Training (BIPSOT) to acknowledge Bangladesh's significant contributions to UN peacekeeping missions and emphasize the importance of women's involvement in peace and security efforts.

Her visit also includes a stop at the Bangladesh Krira Shikkha Protishtan (BKSP), where she will interact with young athletes, including the female hockey team. Additionally, she will attend a British Council event celebrating 75 years of its operations in Bangladesh.

The visit, requested by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office, marks the Duchess's return to Bangladesh after a previous visit in 2017 when she held the title of Countess of Wessex. Her husband, Prince Edward, holds the title Duke of Edinburgh, previously held by his late father, Prince Philip.

headline_marked: Actress Pori Moni [[threatens to kill]] journalist, faces legal notice
headline: Actress Pori Moni threatens to kill journalist, faces legal notice
summary: Actress Pori Moni is accused of snatching a journalist's phone, injuring others, and threatening to kill a reporter on court premises. A legal notice demands an apology.
details: Actress Pori Moni has been served a legal notice demanding an unconditional apology for alleged misconduct and death threats against a journalist. The incident reportedly occurred on court premises when journalists attempted to photograph her.
The notice claims Pori Moni snatched a reporter's mobile phone and her security personnel damaged equipment. It also alleges that several journalists and a litigant were injured during the scuffle.

According to the notice, Pori Moni verbally abused and threatened to kill a multimedia reporter, stating, “Come here. Why did you hold my hand like that?” The reporter reportedly has missing fingers on his right hand.

The legal notice also references an alleged incident where Pori Moni posted a video with "obscene remarks" on Facebook using the national anthem as background music, potentially violating laws protecting the national anthem.
The notice was sent to Pori Moni, as well as the President and General Secretary of the Bangladesh Film Artistes’ Association, urging them to take disciplinary action against the actress.

Lawyer Khandaker Hasan Shahriar, who issued the notice, stated that they are awaiting Pori Moni's response and that further legal steps will be decided based on her actions and the association's response. He emphasized that journalists should not face such incidents while performing their duties.
